helpSwap: s <h> <f>, swap <h> <f>  swap hand card h with field card f
helpPass: p, pass              skip the swap (in the declare window, decline)
helpCounter: c <seat>, counter <seat>  declare Counter-Kemps on opponent seat
helpNext: n, next              advance to the next round
promptExchange: Your turn. Use s <h> <f> to swap, p to pass.
promptDeclare: Declare window! k for Kemps, c <seat> for Counter-Kemps, p to decline.
promptPartnerSignal: Your partner is signaling! Use k (kemps) to declare!
promptOpponentSignal: Something stirs in the opposing team... use c <seat> for Counter-Kemps.
promptNextRound: Round over. Use n (next) to start the next round.
fourOfAKindReady: * Four of a kind! You may declare Kemps (declare / d)
